theme: A wide-open Monday in St. Pete.
greeting: Nothing on the calendar today, Dan — a rare fully open Monday. The girls are with you and Mike this week, so it's a home day with room for the bookings that have been drifting.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since Sep 14 (p1). A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the market's hardest rental and sells out early — book a refundable hold now and adjust dates once the trip firms up.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive-down plan
needsAttention.detail: Overdue Sep 25 (p2). The Oct 5–18 Maine off-week is your window to drive the Pathfinder south — set the two dates and book the single hotel night before it closes.

flagged.title: ICGN Toronto panel — bio needed
flagged.detail: ICGN asked you to moderate a panel at their November Annual Conference; you've drafted a bio and sent it to Drew for a read.

flagged.title: New sign-ins flagged
flagged.detail: Google logged a new Mac OS sign-in and Disney+ a new login overnight — worth a glance to confirm both were you.

inbox.noise: The usual newsletter drift — NYT Cooking, Responsible Investor, the Italian word of the day, and a stack of retailer promos.

resolved.title: ASA 101 certification earned
resolved.detail: American Sailing confirmed your Basic Keelboat cert this morning; Paul had already filled out the logbook on the trip, so Amy stood down and you thanked her — thread closed.

acts.line: The calendar is clear edge to edge — no meetings pull at the day.
An open stretch in St. Petersburg; good hours for the travel bookings that have been waiting on you.
Kids are with you and Mike this week — an ordinary weeknight at home.
